verdict.rationale: Codegen agents can fix bugs, open PRs autonomously, run security/secrets scans on PR diffs, and be triggered from CI/CD (e.g., on build failure), which together could plausibly support security-alert remediation, but there is no direct evidence of an end-to-end workflow that ingests security alerts (e.g., from a scanner/Dependabot), validates them, and auto-opens a remediation PR. missing for 10: explicit security-alert ingestion/triage workflow, evidence of automatic remediation PR creation tied to a specific vulnerability alert, and any customer/independent confirmation of this exact use case.
